network.note: Loopback only. The Wazuh Indexer and PostgreSQL are reached by the app process, not by the agent. Never widen this to arbitrary hosts.

files.note: Never read .env, the live production database, real alert records, or raw logs. Development and QA use synthetic fixtures in tests/ only.

stack.frontend: Vanilla JavaScript ES modules + native CSS (no React/Vue/Tailwind)
